productTitle: Mens Wide Toe Box Running Shoes Lace Up Jacquard Mesh Upper EVA Sole Graphic Panels Sports Sneakers Wholesale EU 39-48
textDesc: Mens wide toe box lace-up running shoes for B2B sports footwear assortments. Black, Orange and Green each offered in EU39-48. Jacquard mesh upper, EVA midsole and EVA sole are specified for this style. Photographs show angular graphic panels, a molded lace eyelet frame, a low collar and a diagonally sculpted sole. Lining and dark bottom patch compositions are not specified. Send color, exact EU size mix, pair quantity, packaging needs and destination for a wholesale quotation. Samples, branding feasibility, costs and dispatch timing require order-specific confirmation.
companyDesc: Quanzhou Beiqiang Footwear & Apparel Co., Ltd. is based in Quanzhou, Fujian, China and serves overseas B2B footwear buyers.
